hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: Manages bonding-curve-style launches of tokenized stock pools where currency0 is always a quote ERC-20 asset. Charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, chosen at launch) split among creator, a "bid wall" (single-sided quote liquidity maintained just below spot price), and a platform treasury. Liquidity addition is gated to the factory until graduation (price crosses a configurable tick threshold), after which the pool opens to external LPs.
